projects_linear_team_check.name: projects_linear_team_check
projects_linear_team_check.value: "projects"."linear_team" IS NULL OR ("projects"."linear_team" GLOB '[A-Z]*' AND length("projects"."linear_team") BETWEEN 1 AND 10)

projects_relative_path_check.name: projects_relative_path_check
projects_relative_path_check.value: "projects"."relative_path" IS NULL OR (trim("projects"."relative_path") <> '' AND "projects"."relative_path" NOT LIKE '/%' AND "projects"."relative_path" NOT LIKE '%..%' AND "projects"."relative_path" NOT LIKE '%/%')

repositories_local_path_check.name: repositories_local_path_check
repositories_local_path_check.value: "repositories"."local_path" IS NULL OR ("repositories"."local_path" LIKE '/%' AND "repositories"."local_path" NOT LIKE '%/../%' AND "repositories"."local_path" NOT LIKE '%/..')

repositories_relative_path_check.name: repositories_relative_path_check
repositories_relative_path_check.value: "repositories"."relative_path" IS NULL OR (trim("repositories"."relative_path") <> '' AND "repositories"."relative_path" NOT LIKE '/%' AND "repositories"."relative_path" NOT LIKE '%..%')
